description: This file defines the SoapError class for handling SOAP fault errors within the SuiteCRM integration. It provides methods to set error details based on predefined error definitions and retrieve error information.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: A class to represent SOAP error details, with methods to set and retrieve error information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SoapError instance with the default 'no_error' state.

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Sets the error details based on the provided error name, using external definitions.

methods.name: get_soap_array
methods.description: Returns the error details as an associative array suitable for SOAP responses.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the error.

methods.name: getFaultCode
methods.description: Retrieves the error number as the fault code.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the error.
